what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from North Macedonia in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 120 asylum seekers from North Macedonia in Italy, 9.0% of all asylum seekers from North Macedonia.
Refugees from North Macedonia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for North Macedonia in these years, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2018 and 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
